subhypothesis: A large modified survival world can be represented exactly by deterministic procedural chunk rules plus a sparse history of resource deltas, with description size tracking edits rather than full world state.

preregistration.negativeControl: same remaining delta values attached to wrong resource IDs
confirmation: wrong-ID control mismatches when at least two edits exist
every radius-16 compressed explicit state is at least 8x the sparse descriptor
median descriptor growth radius 8 to 16 is at most 4.8x
median compressed explicit-state growth radius 8 to 16 is at least 3.2x
preregistration.refutation: Any fixed confirmation criterion fails; thresholds may not be lowered after execution.

boundary: This file preserves an audit copy of the source run for VNO governance. The original branch/commit/file remain the provenance authority. RUN_059 confirms this effect inside the tested generator/resource-delta model; it does not by itself prove that every gameplay system can be represented this way.
